name: todo-nl
title: Todo list you talk to

origin.source: Ported in spirit from v1 todo.ts (next branch)

comparison.purpose: Turns one free-text command into a sequence of typed machine events, one legal event per step of an explicit decide loop, then pauses on an idle state for the next thing you say. Guards refuse a toggle or delete on an id that is not in the list, and a per-command step budget leaves only DONE or QUIT legal, so the loop always ends.

starters: add milk, eggs, and call the dentist
add pay rent and buy stamps, then mark pay rent done
add milk, eggs, and fix the bike, then delete the grocery items
